vec3Grid.description: Rectangular control grid indexed as values[u][v].

numberGrid.description: Rectangular scalar grid indexed as values[u][v].

faceGroups.description: u32x3 triples (faceIndex,indexStart,indexCount); start and count address scalar entries in indices, not triangles.

edgeGroups.description: u32x3 triples (edgeIndex,vertexStart,vertexCount); start and count address f32x3 vertices in positions.

inertia.description: Row-major [Ixx,Ixy,Ixz,Iyx,Iyy,Iyz,Izx,Izy,Izz] in global model coordinates about center.

direction1.description: Optional second thickness vector; it must be zero or collinear and opposite to direction.

matrix12.transformComposition: If matrix is present it is used alone and translation, rotation, scale, scaleOrigin, and mirror are ignored. Otherwise the kernel multiplies parts as T*R*S*M in translation, rotation, scale, mirror declaration order, so points experience mirror first, then scale, then rotation, then translation.

massProperties.frame: global model coordinates about the returned center of mass

geometryEvaluation.curveParameters: Native OCCT edge parameter domain; derivatives are with respect to that parameter.
geometryEvaluation.surfaceParameters: Native OCCT restricted face UV domain; derivatives are with respect to U and V.
geometryEvaluation.surfaceOrientation: The returned normal and signed principal/mean curvatures follow the TopoDS_Face orientation. Gaussian curvature is orientation independent.

bsplineApproximation.parameterization: chordLength maps to Approx_ChordLength, centripetal to Approx_Centripetal, and uniform to Approx_IsoParametric.
bsplineApproximation.surfaceIndexing: Surface samples use zero-based U-major points[u][v], matching the first and second indices of OCCT's point grid.
bsplineApproximation.variationalSmoothing: Optional non-negative length, curvature, and torsion weights select OCCT variational smoothing. At least one weight must be positive; this mode uses degreeMax, continuity, and tolerance and rejects parameterization or degreeMin.

degreeReduction.curve: reduceCurveDegree approximates a bounded Bezier or BSpline edge with an OCCT BSpline of the requested lower degree, preserving the edge domain and orientation; maxError is OCCT's reported 3D deviation.
degreeReduction.surface: reduceSurfaceDegree approximates a bounded Bezier or BSpline face with requested U/V degrees, preserves the face wires and pcurves, and reports OCCT's maximum 3D deviation.
degreeReduction.tolerance: Degree reduction is an approximation; a result is returned only when OCCT reports completion within the requested tolerance, and maxError reports the achieved deviation.

geometryExtension.curve: extendCurve accepts a bounded Bezier or BSpline edge and extends it to the requested 3D endpoint; after defaults to true and continuity is C1, C2, or C3.
geometryExtension.surface: extendSurface accepts a finite face, extends its rectangular outer boundary along U or V, and preserves input hole wires.

surfaceConstruction.filling: makeSurfaceFilling constructs an N-side OCCT filling face from the edges of one closed boundary wire, optionally constrained by interior 3D points and by G1/G2 support faces. Boundary edge indices are zero-based in wire order; unspecified edges use C0.
surfaceConstruction.wireTrimming: makeFaceOnSurface copies input wires, projects missing pcurves onto the support face geometry, and returns a non-rectangular face without mutating the support or wires.

curveControlNet.indexing: poles[index] and weights[index] use zero-based curve-control indexing in the protocol; OCCT one-based indices are not exposed.
curveControlNet.editing: updateCurvePole copies the underlying Bezier or BSpline curve and returns a new edge over the input edge parameter domain with its topology orientation preserved.

surfaceControlNet.indexing: poles[u][v] and weights[u][v] use zero-based U-major indexing in the protocol; OCCT one-based indices are not exposed.
surfaceControlNet.editing: updateSurfacePole copies the underlying Bezier or BSpline surface and rebuilds the result with the input face outer and hole wires and their pcurves.
surfaceControlNet.trimming: trimSurface creates a rectangular face over an increasing finite subset of the input face UV domain and requires a single four-edge input boundary; arbitrary trimmed topology is rejected rather than discarded.

geometryIntersection.tolerance: Intersection tolerance is the BOP fuzzy coincidence value added to shape tolerances, clamped by OCCT to at least Precision::Confusion(); it is not curve approximation error.
geometryIntersection.curveSurfaceSegments: Segment UV endpoints come from the section edge pcurve on the input face, preserving the selected branch across periodic seams.
geometryIntersection.surfaceSurfaceResults: Results contain topology-clipped section edges plus standalone vertices for isolated tangential contacts.

hiddenLineProjection.coordinates: projectHLR returns exact OCCT HLR edge compounds in view coordinates: X points right, Y follows the projected up direction, and Z is zero. direction points from the camera toward the model.
hiddenLineProjection.perspective: For perspective projection, focus is the positive distance from the projection plane to the eye along the opposite of direction.

meshGroups.faceGroups: u32x3 (faceIndex,indexStart,indexCount); indexStart and indexCount count scalar u32 entries in indices, so each triangle contributes 3.
meshGroups.edgeGroups: u32x3 (edgeIndex,vertexStart,vertexCount); vertexStart and vertexCount count f32x3 vertices in positions.
meshGroups.triangulationCoordinates: triangulationData returns face-local nodes transformed by the face location; replaceTriangulation accepts face-local positions, UVs, and normals before face orientation is applied.
meshGroups.validation: validateTriangulation checks finite nodes, optional normals and UVs, triangle index ranges, and near-zero-area triangles; it does not prove that triangles lie inside face boundaries.
meshGroups.repair: repairTriangulation copies the input shape, cleans its mesh, and rebuilds face triangulations with OCCT BRepMesh without changing the input handle.

brep.compatibility: BREP bytes are a cache format bound to the exact running WASM identity, not a cross-version exchange format.
brep.callerResponsibility: Persist the exact running WASM identity with every BREP cache entry and reject mismatches before import. For the official standalone runtime, use the SHA-256 in docs/g0-build.json; for an official isolated Profile, use its artifact SHA-256 in protocol/artifacts.json; for the official shared runtime, use the SHA-256 values of shared-main.wasm and step-shape-exchange.side.wasm from protocol/artifacts.json. The kernel does not embed or validate this identity.

defaults.makeEdgeArc.xDirection: OCCT gp_Ax2 direction derived deterministically from normal
defaults.makeEdgeBSpline.multiplicities: degree+1 at both ends and 1 internally in non-periodic controlPoints mode
defaults.makeSurfaceFace.surface.xDirection: OCCT gp_Ax3 direction derived deterministically from direction
